# Tie-Out

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `DETERMINISTIC-MATH` `TIE-CHECKED` `MATERIALITY-AWARE` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `AUDIT-TRAIL`

Ties every balance-sheet account to a source — subledger, statement, or schedule — and produces a green/red schedule. The close's backbone: red until tied.

## Why these badges

- **`TIE-CHECKED`** — Cross-foots assets = liabilities + equity first; stops if that fails. Then one computed comparison per account.
- **`READ-ONLY`** — Corrections become JE drafts and a pointer to /accruals — never posted from here.
- **`MATERIALITY-AWARE`** — Red rows above materiality keep the close task red; accepted exceptions need a recorded why.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ledger.balance-sheet` | **yes** | integration manifest | balance sheet export as of period end |
| `ar.aging` | no | integration manifest | A/R aging export |
| `ap.aging` | no | integration manifest | A/P aging export |
| `ledger.gl-detail` | no | integration manifest | ask for detail on accounts needing composition analysis |
| `prior close artifacts` | no | closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/ — bank-rec proofs, amortization schedules | redo the work |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| tie-out.md | markdown table | closes/&lt;YYYY-MM&gt;/ — one row per account: balance, source, difference, status, evidence link |
| headline | chat | N green, M red, K accepted |
| correction drafts | JE drafts | chat — with likely cause and recommended fix per red account |

## What it will not do

- Eyeball a difference. Every comparison is scripted.
- Post a correcting entry.
